answer: A remote attestation quotes the enclave code before the identity is allowed to act, and the chain groups identities by quoted measurement, so a farm running one image in one fleet collapses into a single counted voter. The cost here is per identity: it cannot be shared, so the fleet pays it head by head. The ridge is the quoted measurement, the violet the group it forms, and the juniper the voice that group is worth; the ridge and the violet collapse a farm, while only a fresh juniper of hardware escapes the grouping.
